title: Quarter playbook: hosted API + model-cohort sprint templates and OKR mapping
creator: Ava Chen
description: Purpose: Produce a repeatable quarterly playbook that maps hosted API model-catalog cohorts to sprint templates, OKR checkpoints, and cross-team handoffs. The playbook should enable PMs and Eng leads to plan capacity hedges, must-have evaluation gates for new model variants, and an approved canary window schedule. Deliverables: 1) 8-week sprint template with milestones (onboarding, canary, metrics sweep, rollback), 2) OKR mapping doc tying model lineup decisions to cost/latency/reliability targets, 3) risk & contingency matrix with capacity thresholds and fallback routes, 4) templated stakeholder signoff checklist and launch checklist. This ticket coordinates with Console, Serving Runtime, and Research for gate definitions and with Solutions for customer communication windows.
acceptance_criteria: Quarter playbook doc published in Confluence with templates and sample calendar
OKR mapping table that links each cohort to measurable success metrics (latency P50/P95, cost-per-1k tokens, model-quality delta)
Canary window schedule and rollback criteria agreed by Eng leads and SRE
Stakeholder signoff checklist and sample customer communication draft available
Two pilot sprints planned with one internal canary and one limited external cohort run

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Model-quality regressions during canary could cause customer-facing errors. Mitigation: mandatory automated eval + manual spot-check + rollback policy.
Risk: Capacity shortfalls during pilot. Mitigation: reserve dedicated burst capacity and pre-authorize fallback routing to lower-cost variants.
Risk: Misaligned incentives across teams (latency vs cost). Mitigation: include explicit OKR trade-off lanes and tieback to SRE/infra budget owners.
